title: TRUSTWORTHY LARGE MODELS IN VISION: A SURVEY

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying existing literature and providing empirical examples by prompting text-to-image models (e.g., Stable Diffusion XL, DALL-E 2) with profession-based terms like 'great scientists' or 'flight attendants' to observe gender distribution, stereotypical associations, and over-sexualization in the generated images.

Reviewing studies and generating examples that evaluate text-to-image models by pairing positive or negative adjectives with prompts, and analyzing the resulting racial demographics (e.g., generating white men by default for positive words, or associating non-white people with negative adjectives) to assess the reinforcement of racial stereotypes.
